clue.text: Spotted piece showing the same note and number

parts.note: DO is short for ditto, meaning the same as before
MI is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A game piece that shows a matching note and number.
explanation.walkthrough: DO is the abbreviation of ditto, written to say 'the same again', rather than the sol-fa note it resembles.
explanation.definitionFit: Each tile in the game has pips, so it is a piece covered in spots.

clue.text: Strippers who hand out awards?

definitions.meaning: people who peel old paper off walls before redoing a room
people who confer medals or honours on others

explanation.surface: Exotic dancers who also present prizes.
explanation.definitionFit: Painters strip walls, and those who decorate heroes pin medals on them.

clue.text: Take away copper and half of lead from rear of toy?

indicators.note: from rear of says these pieces are taken off the back end of the word for toy

parts.note: toy as an adjective means tiny, very small
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: half of keeps the first two of the four letters of lead

explanation.surface: Removing copper and some lead from the back of a toy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half of' gives LE; with CU it comes off the end of MINUSCULE.
explanation.definitionFit: To subtract is to take one number away from another, as the arithmetic sign says.

clue.text: Terrible sound drowns old mike

indicators.note: drowns means swallows up, so the sound engulfs the other letters

parts.note: noise is sound
Mike is the NATO alphabet word for M

explanation.surface: A dreadful racket overwhelms an old microphone.
explanation.definitionFit: Offensive and horrible, especially of smells, so very bad indeed.

clue.text: Romantic English celebs pursue papers

indicators.note: to pursue is to come after, so these pieces follow the papers

parts.note: ID means identity papers
the A-list is the set of top celebrities

explanation.surface: An English gossip piece in which celebrities are chased by the newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic as a noun is a dreamer with lofty visions, which is what this person is.

clue.text: Drove fast northwards, expelling black discharge

indicators.note: expelling throws out, so one letter is removed
in a down entry going northwards means reading upwards, backwards

parts.note: bombed is slang for drove fast
B is the pencil abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: Someone sped north, shedding a black discharge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'northwards' reverses BOMBED to DEBMOB; 'expelling' then drops one B.
explanation.definitionFit: Releasing someone from military service is the informal short form of demobilise.

clue.text: Mariner loves crackers free from 12

parts.note: AB is an able seaman

indicators.note: crackers means crazy, so the letters go wild

explanation.surface: A sailor is mad about his loved ones, free of duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 12 is the duty answer above, so the definition means to release from obligation.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve someone is to release them from blame or obligation.

clue.text: The writer's free to keep amounts regularly, like gold?

indicators.note: to keep is to hold, so the writer's words hold the letters inside

parts.note: the writer is the setter, so the writer's is I'm
able means free to, permitted

indicators.note: regularly takes every second letter of amounts

explanation.surface: An author keeps track of sums, as reliable as gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks MUT from 'amounts'; 'free to' is one phrase meaning permitted.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold does not tarnish or corrode, so it seems unchanging forever.

clue.text: Pin down heading

definitions.meaning: to fasten with small nails, as a carpet
a sailing boat's course or direction on one leg

explanation.surface: An instruction to fix a heading in place.
explanation.definitionFit: Small nails fasten carpets; a sailing boat changes course on each leg.

clue.text: Breach is limiting newspaper complaint

indicators.note: limiting means enclosing, so these words go around the newspaper

parts.note: a burst is a breach or rupture
the i is a British newspaper

explanation.surface: A broken water pipe limits the newspaper's delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation of a fluid sac at a joint is a medical ailment.

clue.text: Cobalt miners maintain one rotating sequence

parts.note: Co is the chemical symbol for cobalt

indicators.note: to maintain is to hold, so the miners' union holds the turned word inside it

parts.note: NUM is the National Union of Mineworkers, the British miners' union

indicators.note: rotating turns the word for one round, so it is read backwards

parts.note: a unit is one single thing

explanation.surface: Cobalt miners keep one machine turning in a steady run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rotating' gives TINU; NUM is Britain's National Union of Mineworkers.
explanation.definitionFit: A continuous series that passes without breaks from one value to the next is a sequence in that sense.

clue.text: Problem with current tree

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem
AC is alternating current

explanation.surface: An electrician has trouble with the power supply near a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A sumac is a shrub or small tree whose berries give a tart spice.

clue.text: Duty that could be tinier possibly?

indicators.note: could be says the letters of the following words might form something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: A question asking whether a duty might be made smaller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' signals the anagram of all fourteen letters of TINIER POSSIBLY.
explanation.definitionFit: An obligation you are bound to carry out is a duty, the same idea in a longer word.

clue.text: More intelligence keeps European outside

parts.note: extra means more

indicators.note: keeps means holds, so the intelligence word contains the letter

parts.note: nous is common sense or intelligence

explanation.surface: Smarter people keep a European foreigner out.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming from beyond or irrelevant to the matter, so external.

clue.text: Point about women's tier?

indicators.note: about means around, so the point goes around the letter for women

parts.note: a tine is a prong or point, as on a fork
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: A query about the status of women in some ranking tier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tier' is read as 'tie-er', a thing that ties, not a layer or rank; the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: String used for tying parcels is something that ties, a tier in the quirky sense.

clue.text: Units occupying subcontinent and country further east

indicators.note: occupying means sitting within, so the units go inside

parts.note: India is the subcontinent
ones are units

explanation.surface: Troops occupying the subcontinent and a land further east.
explanation.definitionFit: This archipelago state lies east of the Indian subcontinent in Southeast Asia.

clue.text: Foreign article in metal case that may go up at any time

definitions.text: that may go up at any time

indicators.note: in places the German article within the metal case

parts.note: a tin box is a case made of metal
der is the German definite article

explanation.surface: A foreign item kept in a metal case that might explode at any moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A box of dry kindling, or figuratively a tense situation, is liable to burst into flames at any moment.

clue.text: Nothing's smarter than this new manifest I installed

indicators.note: installed means placed inside, so I goes into the word for manifest

parts.note: to attest is to show clearly, to manifest

explanation.surface: Boasting about a smart new manifest installed.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of smart: if something is the most dapper, nothing exceeds it.

clue.text: Relay touching silicon in store

parts.note: re means touching or concerning, as in a memo heading

indicators.note: in puts the silicon symbol inside the word for store

parts.note: a depot is a store or warehouse
Si is the chemical symbol for silicon

explanation.surface: A relay race baton change involving silicon held in a warehouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relay' is read as re-lay, to lay down again, not a race or a passing on.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay something down a second time is to put it in place again, to set down anew.

clue.text: Calm spot to hold a tango

indicators.note: to hold means to contain, so the spot goes round the letters

parts.note: a place is a spot
Tango is the NATO alphabet word for T

explanation.surface: A quiet dance floor where a tango is held.
explanation.definitionFit: To pacify an angry person is to soothe or calm them.

clue.text: Dim British king

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's tragic king

explanation.surface: A description of an unintelligent British monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Bleary or blear eyes see indistinctly, so the word means misty or faint.

clue.text: Showing off poster during what follows 22

indicators.note: during means within, so the poster goes inside the other word

parts.note: 22 is the first NATO alphabet word; the second is Bravo
ad is short for advertisement, a poster

explanation.surface: Someone flaunting a poster during a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravado is a boastful display of boldness, a form of swagger.

clue.text: Old Peruvian quote about father's disability

parts.note: the Incas ruled ancient Peru
pa is an informal word for father
a citation is a quotation

explanation.surface: An ancient Peruvian's words quoted concerning his father's handicap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' just links the quote to the father here; nothing goes round anything.
explanation.definitionFit: Being made incapable of acting is a state of disablement, an inability.

clue.text: Top star to risk leaving all the letters we need

indicators.note: leaving means going away from, so the risk word departs

parts.note: the alphabet holds every letter we need to write
to bet is to risk money

explanation.surface: A top celebrity risks abandoning all the letters needed.
explanation.definitionFit: In astronomy the brightest star in a constellation gets the first Greek letter, so it is top.

clue.text: What's in divine vessel? Rich, ornate contents

indicators.note: contents means what is held within these words

explanation.surface: A query about what a rich, ornate holy vessel contains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' means a blood vessel, not a chalice.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth ichor is the fluid that flows in the veins of the gods.

clue.text: Flog whiskey with fruit

parts.note: Whiskey is the NATO alphabet word for W
a hip is the fruit of the rose

explanation.surface: Selling whiskey along with fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat with a lash is to flog; this tool or act does that.

clue.text: Measure of area surrounding east German plant

indicators.note: surrounding means the area unit goes round the German word

parts.note: ha is the symbol for hectare
Ost is German for east

explanation.surface: A plot measurement around an East German plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A hosta is a shade-loving garden perennial grown for its leaves.

clue.text: Greek character in patio's sickly, sort of green

indicators.note: in places the Greek letter within the jumbled patio letters
something sickly is out of sorts, so these letters are disordered

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek man sitting on a patio painted a sickly green shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sickly' rearranges the patio letters into PISTAO.
explanation.definitionFit: The nut gives its name to a pale yellowish-green colour.

clue.text: Locate dull table item

parts.note: to place something is to locate or identify it
matt or mat means dull, not glossy

explanation.surface: Finding a boring piece of tableware.
explanation.definitionFit: A small mat under a diner's plate protects the table surface.

clue.text: Minor perhaps beginning to madden Iris

indicators.note: beginning to takes the first letter of the next word

parts.note: orris is a kind of iris whose root is used in perfume

explanation.surface: A young person who starts to anger someone called Iris.
explanation.walkthrough: The Morris Minor was a classic British small car, so 'Minor' is an example of the make.
explanation.definitionFit: The Minor was a model built by this British car maker, so it is an example.
